data.title: 结城明日奈 · 闪光的细剑连击·「攻略就交给我吧，绝对不会输的！」
data.description: 【浮游城艾恩葛朗特迷宫区高层】险峻昏暗的地下城迷宫中，悬浮的魔法水晶闪烁着冷冽紫芒。身着血盟骑士团红白骑士战袍的亚丝娜轻盈前踏，手中的细剑「闪烁之光」绽放出凌厉绚烂的五连击金色剑气光芒。栗色长发在狂风中疾舞，那双坚定英气的琥珀色双眸中满载着副团长的自信与威严。
data.location: 艾恩葛朗特第74层迷宫区深处主回廊
data.action: 弓步突刺疾驰，手持细剑闪烁之光迸发出撕裂空气的金色剑技光轨，红白战袍飘扬，琥珀眼眸锐利自信
data.lighting: 细剑剑技爆发出璀璨耀眼的白金流光与迷宫水晶的幽紫环境光
data.camera: dynamic wide shot, high-speed sword action, particle light trails, dramatic motion blur
data.promptProse: Asuna steps forward through Aincrad's high-floor dungeon, guiding Lambent Light through a rapid five-strike sequence. Her white-and-crimson Knights of the Blood Oath uniform and chest armor remain distinct beneath flying chestnut hair and focused amber eyes. The wide action view shows angular stone passages and floating crystals behind her. White-gold sword light illuminates her lead hand and tunic edge; violet crystal glow separates distant walls from the darker corridor openings.
